material_findings.evidence: scripts/score_cue.py cmd_render, compose, post_process; SKILL.md render example
material_findings.finding: The JSON name is interpolated into MIDI, raw/final WAV and report paths without a basename or containment check. Absolute or parent-relative names can escape outdir; existing files and symlink targets are not protected. MIDI save, ffmpeg forced replacement and report write can replace existing content, including before a later validation failure. Require safe leaf names, bounded fresh workspace, no-follow/exclusive output handling and explicit replacement permission.

Untrusted JSON values are inserted directly into FFmpeg filtergraph expressions, including a freeform loudnorm string and fade fields. Argument arrays avoid shell interpolation but do not prevent filter-language injection. Unrestricted input paths and whole decoded audio buffering plus missing numeric/resource limits also weaken isolation. Use typed validated fields, fixed filter graph, approved local files, explicit stream selection, bounded decoding and time/resource limits.

The inclusive median comparisons accept both quiet and loud checks at the same constant level, including silence; out-of-range timecodes are matched to the nearest existing window; unknown expectations are not failed. cmd_measure exits nonzero only for clipping, not failed storyboard checks. Enforce positive dynamic margins, valid ranges and labels, nonempty finite audio, and consistent failure status.

material_findings.evidence: SKILL.md measurement and variants; scripts/score_cue.py load_channels, measure, cmd_fingerprint
material_findings.finding: Sample peak does not certify true peak or loudness, mean downmix can cancel opposing channels, and the probe selects first audio stream but decoding does not explicitly map it. Distinct rounded duration/peak/centroid tuples prove only those metrics differ, not the intended instrument or arrangement; identical tuples do not prove byte identity. Bind comparisons to changed parameters, decoded signal identity and target metrics.

material_findings.evidence: SKILL.md Route A, music under voice-over
material_findings.finding: A MIDI event schedule does not guarantee exact audible onset or envelope after synthesis. FFmpeg linear normalization can fall back to dynamic behavior; the instruction does not require verifying normalization_type. One model experiment cannot prove all generative systems lack timed control. Verify actual mode, true peak, integrated loudness and timing against the delivery contract; retain human listening acceptance.

positive_safeguards: Separates quantitative checks from human listening judgments; explicit peak/duration checks and warns about failed variant substitution.
Starter init refuses existing destination unless force; subprocess argument lists avoid shell interpolation; discourages bulk credential retrieval.
records.remediation: Contain and stage writes, disallow untrusted filter syntax, enforce strict bounded input and output contracts, fail closed on silent/invalid storyboard checks, verify true peak/loudness and actual normalization mode, and require separately authorized provider/asset operations and exact rights receipts.
